name: Two glowing circles
what: Two glowing circles open one after the other on a dark board, each with a word typed into it: a dot swells and ripples out into nested rings, the camera swings across to the second circle, then pulls back so both sit side by side and drift gently until the end.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f3-f8 (00:00:00:03-00:00:00:08) a dot swells; f9-f12 (00:00:00:09-00:00:00:12) it ripples out into a ring; f5-f20 (00:00:00:05-00:00:00:20) the first word types in letter by letter while rings settle; f41-f66 (00:00:01:11-00:00:02:06) the camera pans across to circle B (S-curve, fastest f49-f56), which opens and types on the way in (f51-f56); f92-f116 (00:00:03:02-00:00:03:26) the camera pulls back and swings home so both circles sit side by side; then a slow drift up and down to f299 (00:00:09:29)
